name: JSK Investments
decision_note: Kijonka family investment group running a self-managed SICAV that takes qualified-investor money (min EUR 125k) and whose main strategy is majority stakes in mid-size companies (Private & Growth Equity) - pe, so outside the VC pilot (S1); its separately branded VC fund is the record jsk-investments-venture-capital.

legal_entities.name: JSK Investments Private and Growth Equity Fund I, podfond
JSK Investments Family Evergreen Equity Fund I, podfond

funds.name: JSK Investments SICAV a.s. (founders' commitment at launch)

evidence.quote: Jsme investiční skupina s vlastním kapitálem a zkušenostmi z budování úspěšných firem.
Podporujeme inovativní startupy, zavedené podniky i rodinné projekty.
Investiční fond JSK Investments SICAV a.s. se zapojil do investičního kola britské společnosti MintNeuro, v němž firma získala 5 milionů USD.
Výčet investorů doplňuje investiční skupina JSK Simony Kijonkové a jejího manžela Jaromíra Kijonky.
V rámci Private & Growth Equity se zaměřujeme na majoritní kapitálové vstupy do středně velkých firem napříč tržními sektory.

Pod hlavičkou JSK Investments vznikl samosprávný investiční fond kvalifikovaných investorů typu SICAV, do kterého je možné vstoupit s minimální investicí 125 tisíc eur, což jsou v přepočtu zhruba tři miliony korun.

Podfond Private & Growth Equity se soustředí na majoritní podíly ve středně velkých firmách s investičním horizontem pět až osm let a má klást důraz na škálování a rozvoj v odvětvích jako e-commerce, logistika, rychloobrátkové zboží, výroba a zdravotnictví.

Společně s manželem Jaromírem Kijonkou už před osmi lety založili investiční skupinu JSK Investments a v rámci ní teď rozjíždí investiční fond, do kterého sami Kijonkovi vkládají zhruba dvě miliardy korun.

evidence.publisher: JSK Investments (JSK Venture Capital Fund site)
evidence.quote: Capital is managed independently and is not shared across investment strategies.

analyst_notes: BORDERLINE: JSK presents itself as an investment group with its own capital (CVCA, e1) supporting startups, established companies and family projects (e2). Since 2025-2026 it runs a self-managed SICAV (JSK Investments SICAV a.s., ČNB-authorised above the threshold) with a Private & Growth Equity sub-fund (majority stakes in mid-size companies, e5; public offering of shares), a Venture Capital sub-fund (IČO 75166372, registered 2026-02-24; its investment director is quoted on the MintNeuro deal) and a Family Evergreen sub-fund. Startup deals: Vetstor EUR 1m round (Dec 2025, CzechCrunch) and MintNeuro USD 5m round led by Odyssey Ventures (release dated 2026-10-09; the homepage listing shows 10.10.2026). Typed private_investor with secondary vc and pe and excluded S1 per the brief for private investment groups; if the reviewer treats the VC sub-fund as a stand-alone Czech VC, the record should be re-typed vc and included (activity and legal entities are already evidenced). Facts (focus, ticket, capital) were not researched further. [revision 2026-10-25 after review: type private_investor -> pe (secondary vc removed); decision stays exclude S1. The 'own capital only' ground was wrong: the self-managed SICAV is open to qualified investors from EUR 125k (e6) with external money to follow, and its dominant strategy is the Private & Growth Equity sub-fund taking majority stakes in mid-size companies (e5, e7; reviewer: EUR 100m target for the PE fund vs EUR 20m for VC) - pe. Under the brand rule the separately branded VC fund (JSK Investments Venture Capital Fund I, own site jskinvestments.ventures, own team, capital managed independently, e9) is now its own record cz-vc/jsk-investments-venture-capital.json; its sub-fund legal entity (IČO 75166372) and the MintNeuro and Vetstor investments moved there (e3, e4 kept here as context for the SICAV). Group facts now describe the PE strategy: sectors from the PGE sub-fund description (e-commerce, logistics, FMCG, manufacturing, healthcare; the SICAV page says 'across market sectors', e5), stage buyout. Capital: the founders put 'roughly CZK 2bn' into the fund at launch (e8) - recorded as interim_close (committed so far, fund still raising; approximate figure) with a matching commitment event; no fund close or fund size is published. Geography and ticket of the PE strategy not published.]
